description: Autologic Industries is a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Sri Lanka, exporting quality-checked clutch and engine spares for many bike models.

hero_sub: Keeping the Island’s Bikes Serviced on Schedule
hero: Most Sri Lankan riders bring their motorcycles in for service at regular intervals, and each visit is a chance for a dealer to sell clutch and engine spares. As a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Sri Lanka, we help dealers make the most of those visits with dependable parts for several popular models.
Everything comes from our IATF 16949 certified plant in India, where machining, casting and heat treatment are all done in-house. That control keeps every reorder consistent.
Colombo is only a short voyage away, so restocking between larger orders is practical rather than a long wait.
Orders arrive boxed by model, which makes it easy to split stock between outlets after clearance.

faq_intro: Questions Sri Lankan dealers ask about our motorcycle spares.
faqs: Can stock be split between outlets?
Yes. Cartons can be labelled per outlet before shipping.
Who makes the parts?
We do, at our IATF 16949 certified plant in India.
Which spares sell best at service time?
Clutch plates and other wear parts usually move fastest; we can suggest a starting list for your models.
How long does shipping take?
The sea crossing to Colombo is short; we confirm dates with each order.
Can I order a small first shipment?
Yes. A trial order lets you judge demand before scaling up.
Can boxes show our brand?
Yes, with your brand and part numbers.
Do you supply delivery fleets?
Yes, with spares planned around their service intervals.
Do you supply parts for older models still on the road?
Where a model is still common, we can often supply matching spares. Send the model and part number to check.
How do you help new dealers get started?
We suggest a first order based on the models in your area, then adjust later shipments using your sales figures.
What paperwork comes with each shipment?
A commercial invoice, packing list by model and the other documents your clearing agent requests for import into Sri Lanka.
Can you recommend which new lines to add?
Yes. As your sales history builds, we suggest additional lines based on the models your service centres see most often, so your range grows where demand already exists.
